35 The diagram shows a rectangular block with dimensions x, 2x and 3x.
top face P
2x
3x
Q
R
R
Q
x
bottom face P
Electrical contact can be made to the block between opposite pairs of faces (for example,
between the faces labelled R).
Which statement describing the electrical resistance of the block is correct?
A
It is maximum between the faces labelled P.
B
It is maximum between the faces labelled Q.
C
It is maximum between the faces labelled R.
D
It is the same, whichever pair of faces is used.

hints: Notice the three edge lengths $x$, $2x$ and $3x$ and work out for each pair P, Q and R what is the distance $L$ between the faces and what is the contact area $A$ of one face.
Recall $R = \rho L/A$, so resistance is larger when current must travel further and through a smaller cross-sectional area.
Compare the ratio $L/A$ for P with $x/6x^2$, for Q with $3x/2x^2$ and for R with $2x/3x^2$ to see which is greatest.
walkthrough: Identify $L$ and $A$ for each choice from the $x$ by $2x$ by $3x$ block. Top and bottom P faces have area $3x \times 2x = 6x^2$ separated by $x$.
End Q faces have area $2x \times x = 2x^2$ separated by $3x$. Side R faces have area $3x \times x = 3x^2$ separated by $2x$.
State the governing relation $R = \rho L/A$ where $\rho$ is the same for the same block, so only $L/A$ matters.
Compare: $1/6 < 2/3 < 3/2$, so $L/A$ and therefore $R$ is smallest for P, intermediate for R and largest for Q.
Maximum resistance is therefore between the Q faces. This is option B

A.explanation: Between P the length is shortest at $x$ and the area is largest at $6x^2$, so $R = \rho L/A$ is minimum, not maximum.

B.explanation: Between Q the length is longest at $3x$ and the area is smallest at $2x^2$, so $R = \rho L/A$ is largest.

C.explanation: Between R the ratio is intermediate with $L = 2x$ and $A = 3x^2$, so its resistance is between the P and Q values.

D.explanation: Resistance depends on $L/A$, which changes when a different pair of faces is chosen, so it cannot be the same.
